meta.title: If An Eighth Step Appears On Your Mirror... WIPE THE GLASS CLEAN

sources.epidemic_new: film/_work/samples/epidemic/{sfx,music} (owner downloads; use FIRST when present)

rules: every one-shot lands on its picture time; hits within -0.05..+0.10 s of the frame; the bed dips 15 dB in the 0.3 s before each hit
loop_id cues (sprinkler A/B, drip) must use the identical rendered sample each time (the time loop is heard)
nail_click_glass at 143.29 and 690.19 is the same sample

perspective: close (dry, near), inside (cabin room), outside (night exterior), far (distance + low-pass), mirror (heard through glass: low-pass 4 kHz, hollow comb, -4 dB), memory (low-pass 5 kHz, light tape wow, wide reverb), phone (band-pass), dry (design layers)
music the whole time (>= 97 %), bed -11.5 LU under the voice, LRA 17, 85 % of bed energy below 250 Hz, unpulsed minor drone with a flat-2 rub
a riser of +13 LU over 5 s peaks at voice level ON each rule card, then decays over 4-5 s

ambience_camp_night.desc: camp night bed: crickets, frogs, pine wind, lake lapping, rare owl (replaces suburban ambience_night)
ambience_camp_night.build: E "forest night crickets frogs lake"; L oculus forest night loop

ambience_dawn.desc: the other side: a dawn chorus that repeats EXACTLY every 19.48 s (the loop), no wind

ambience_memory.desc: memories: bright summer morning, lake lap, gulls, far kids, tape wow and low-pass

ambience_mirror.desc: inside the glass: hollow glassy room tone, faint high whine, sub pressure

bare_foot_step.desc: the queen's bare foot on a stair tread: wet slap, low weight

bed_creak.desc: bunk bed / mattress springs: sit, scoot, pat (kind pat = soft hand pat on the mattress)

bell_clean.desc: THE FAKE BELL: one perfect clean bell note, long beautiful reverb, no rattle (far)
bell_clean.build: E "hand bell ring single"; S modal bell, D5

bell_cracked.desc: THE REAL BELL: clean note then a thin rattle like a dropped spoon (strike padlock|clapper|drop|touch|roll, part note|rattle)
bell_cracked.build: E "hand bell" + "spoon drop" layered; S rattle = amplitude-modulated buzz

body_fall.build: E "body fall wood floor"; L impacts soft heavy

bus_door.desc: memory: school bus door hiss and idle

candy_wrapper.desc: cellophane twist wrapper crinkle (hand, fist, palm)

chair_scrape.desc: a kitchen chair scraping back (heard through the phone)

clock_tick_backward.desc: a heavy clock tick reversed (TOCK-tick), n reverse ticks
clock_tick_backward.build: S from clock_tick reversed + lower pitch

cloth_grab.desc: a hand grabbing a sleeve, collar or shoulder

cloth_press.desc: fabric stretching over fingertips; satin rustle of the queen's dress; cotton seams straining

coffee_percolator.desc: a camp coffee percolator bubbling far away

crate_break.desc: kicking a slatted crate apart: crack and splinter
crate_break.build: E "wooden crate break kick"; L impacts plank

drop_reverse.desc: a drip played backward rising (the drop coming up), and the suck-back on loop resets
drop_reverse.build: S from water_drip reversed + pitch rise

footsteps_gravel.desc: footsteps on a gravel / pine-needle path (wet=True for wet grass, soft=True sneaking)

footsteps_run.desc: someone running away on gravel and porch boards (approach=-1)

gate_chain.desc: chain pulled through gate bars; fence rattle; kind tape_flutter = plastic tape fluttering

glass_resonance.desc: glass pane ring / hum hit layer (rule cards, reveals, glass going dark)
glass_resonance.build: L score/percussion/bowed_metals + vibraring; S modal glass

glass_wipe.desc: towel or sleeve wiping glass: squeal strokes (strokes=n, soft=True for the rule-card write-on)

jacket_cloth.desc: canvas work jacket: scrape on a frame, swish, taken off

kids_far.desc: memory: kids giggling under blankets / mess hall chatter, far and filtered

kitchen_far.desc: distant camp kitchen: clinks, a griddle hiss

lace_pull.desc: a shoelace pulled through eyelets (n pulls)

lipstick_draw.desc: waxy lipstick stroke on glass (squeak + crumbly drag); clean=True: thinner, glassy, too-perfect line

lipstick_smear.desc: finger smearing lipstick on glass; kind crumb = tiny crumbs rubbed between fingers

mirror_handle.desc: wooden mirror frame: scrape on floorboards, creak in the grip, bump

sections.mood: cold glassy dread, one huge hit, then grief
sections.source: new Epidemic "dark drone" in D if downloaded, else in_continuum_dream_cave (D) low section
sections.layers: sub drone, music-box bell motif (D5-F5-E5-A4), WIPE THE GLASS hit + braam
sections.notes: bed dips 6 dB under the premise lines 5-6; the hit at 3.92 is one of the three loudest bed moments of the film

sections.layers: low strings swell under the time card, music-box motif on the memory inserts

sections.source: tefu continues; score.py music-box over the towel memories
sections.layers: soft tick pulse while sneaking past the caretaker (67.5-71.4), memory pads
sections.notes: the real cracked bell is planted at 65.92 in a memory

sections.mood: creeping build to the eighth step, then the rule hook
sections.layers: silence 117.6 -> hit 118.87, punch-in hits, a 7 s riser into the rule 1 card

sections.mood: discovery inside the glass; the queen's first turn
sections.source: a_massive_mist_ethan_sloan (B) mid sections for the old-cabin reflection; drones return for the stairs
sections.layers: warm detuned pad for the too-normal reflection (154-174), silence before the voice (181.6), grief dip for the voicemail (186-196), silence + hit on the head turn (198.15)

sections.mood: the hand, the wish, "You have it", the doorway
sections.source: dark_forebodings_ethan_sloan (A#) for 211-260; drop to drones for the doorway
sections.layers: grief dip 218-237, silence 247 -> "You have it" hit, stinger on the fingers, braam on the doorway
sections.notes: do not layer the D drone under the A# track; crossfade at 210.9 and 260.4

sections.mood: the queen's face; stepping into the too-normal dawn
sections.source: drones + stinger for 269-290; then score.py: music-box + warm detuned pad + soft strings (the dawn world has no horror track)
sections.layers: pulse_on at the face (283.8), pulse off at the step-through, stopped-time tinnitus on the hanging drop, swell into 45
sections.notes: the dawn side must sound still and clean: no low rumble, no wind

sections.mood: the loop; grief; the morning he vanished
sections.source: tefu (D) + score.py piano and strings; memory pads for 398.9-446
sections.layers: hit on the face flash (367.8), silence 397.3, memory swell, riser into rule 5
sections.notes: the quietest bed of the film is the memory stretch (-18 LU); never fully silent

sections.mood: urgency, temptation, the fake bell, the real bell
sections.source: from_hell_christoffer_moe_ditlevsen (A#) for 449-478 and 499-535; score.py only for the temptation (481-499)
sections.layers: low pulse in, temptation dip to -18 LU, fake bell in a cleared space, the deepest silence (533.2-534.95), REAL BELL hit
sections.notes: the fake bell must be the most beautiful sound in the film; the real bell the ugliest

sections.mood: climax: escape, aging, the shoe, the foot below yours
sections.source: from_hell peak sections, then new Epidemic "horror tension build" if downloaded
sections.layers: climax pulse, silence 588.6 -> "Wait" hit, thin bed at 595-600 (memory), biggest hit at 605.21
sections.notes: loudest minute of the bed except the very end

sections.layers: riser into rule 7, wipes, silence while the foot hangs, sub drop when the glass goes dark, then near silence

sections.mood: relief and grief, then the phone
sections.source: new Epidemic "emotional strings piano" if downloaded, else score.py strings + piano
sections.layers: warm swell on "Hi, Mom", a true pause (661.6), final riser from 677.4, final stinger 696.9, hard out at 698.62
sections.notes: after black: one faint perfect bell note

epidemic_wishlist.note: The owner offered to download Epidemic files for this film into film/_work/samples/epidemic/{sfx,music}. These are the searches that would lift the sound most; everything has a fallback (free library or synthesis).

wet barefoot footsteps on wood; wet sneaker squelch
towel flap, cloth throw, cloth drop on floor

tape peel, medical tape
flashlight switch on/off
phone text message notification
screen door open and slam with spring
chair scrape on floor
coffee percolator; distant kitchen ambience
footsteps on gravel path walking and running
forest night ambience with crickets and frogs near a lake (2-3 min)
dawn birds / morning chorus, summer, calm (1-2 min)
summer camp / lake morning ambience with distant kids

sad piano with low strings, slow, D minor (grief)
horror tension build with slow pulse and risers, climaxing (2-3 min)
emotional strings and piano, reunion / bittersweet, D (1 track)
a few horror stingers, braams and risers with long tails (the new film needs ~60 hits)
